summary: T11 incremental sync collection is correctly implemented: opaque HMAC-signed tokens, ordered change-log paging with no-skip guarantee, RFC 6578 deletion representation, and safe failure on invalid tokens. All 133 tests pass.
important_context: stamp_change_resource_name in the DAV delete path is a post-commit safety net; if it fails the deleted href degrades to an empty name but the 404 status is still emitted
